description: This file defines the ORM entity class 'InterviewInterviewer' which maps to the database table 'ohrm_job_interview_interviewer', representing the relationship between interviews and interviewers within the application. It includes mappings for two foreign key relations: 'interview' and 'interviewer'.

classes.name: InterviewInterviewer
classes.description: An entity class representing the relation between an interview and its interviewer within the recruitment module.
